overview_description.description: Cinder develops software for trust and safety operations. Its platform manages content moderation, investigations, case workflows, policies, enforcement actions, human review, quality assurance, detection models, and operational metrics. Cinder provides tools for organizations to combine automated and human decisions, evaluate model and reviewer performance, and maintain records for compliance and oversight. The company also offers managed moderation, data labeling, applicant screening, and red-teaming services for digital products and AI systems.

product.name: Cinder Trust and Safety Platform
product.description: A software platform for managing trust and safety operations, including moderation, investigations, enforcement, and review workflows.

product.name: Workflows
product.description: A no-code workflow tool that routes content, users, or other entities through automated and human review steps.

product.name: Human Review and Case Management
product.description: Tools for human review, investigations, case records, collaboration, permissions, and escalation management.

product.name: Policies and Enforcement
product.description: A policy and enforcement system for converting safety rules into review, routing, and action workflows.

product.name: Quality Assurance
product.description: Quality assurance tools for sampling decisions, comparing reviewers and models, and monitoring accuracy and process adherence.

product.name: Detection Management
product.description: A model management tool for building, connecting, benchmarking, and tuning content and safety detectors.
